description: 1 master suite (en-suite bathroom), 2 single bedrooms, 1 shared full bathroom, 1 WC, open plan living-kitchen-dining, 1 storage room. Double-aspect apartment, windows on two facades. En-suite bathroom (9.4sqm) directly accessible from master bedroom. Kitchen at bottom-left of open plan space, wall counter, no kitchen island. Cook faces wall, back to seating area. Living arrangement: seating top-left, dining bottom-left, kitchen bottom-center. Dining table visible, approximately 6 seats. TV visible in seating area. Bathroom config: 1 en-suite bathroom; 1 shared full bathroom; 1 WC. Good parallel morning routine capacity, en-suite serves master, shared bathroom and WC serve rest of household. 2 single bedrooms (14.6sqm and 13.8sqm) from corridor, both large enough for bunk bed. Possible configurations, mutually exclusive: (1) two children's bedrooms; (2) one children's bedroom and one home office; (3) two home offices; (4) one or both as guest rooms; (5) bunk bed arrangement. Cannot simultaneously provide two children's bedrooms and a home office without bunk bed. Storage room in corridor zone, suitable for coats, bikes, laundry or utility storage. Entry from right. Door separates entry corridor from living area. Suits families with one or two children, households working from home.
not_suitable_for: two children's bedrooms and a home office simultaneously without bunk bed
